header: 4Gradients Add Little to Token Recovery but Much to Whole-Document Recovery

images.caption: Figure 7:Token recovery for all 40 attack configurations of the main experiment, at depthsL∈{3,6}L{\in}\{3,6\}, with the public and trained copies of the client’s layers. The 28 configurations without a defence are above the divider, the 12 defended ones below. Each entry aggregates 5,120 document-level evaluations over 256 distinct held-out documents. Depth three generally leaks more than depth six, and the trained copy leaks more than the public copy throughout. The backward-only heuristic reverses the depth ordering (≈24%{\approx}24\%at depth three against50%50\%at depth six). In the defended rows, token recovery drops under secret mixup and stays close to the undefended rows under replica-median, as described in Section4.5.
